releases.title: Mirzapur: The Movie
releases.synopsis: The battle for Mirzapur’s throne intensifies as old enemies resurface and a new threat emerges in the form of Babban Babua, a ruthless businessman from Jaisalmer with ambitions of his own. As the Tripathis face enemies from both the past and present, loyalties are tested while Guddu and Bablu Pandit fight to establish themselves in the power struggle for Mirzapur.

releases.title: Dhamaal 4
releases.synopsis: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

releases.title: Silo
releases.synopsis: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.

releases.title: A Minecraft Movie
releases.synopsis: Four misfits find themselves struggling with ordinary problems when they are suddenly pulled through a mysterious portal into the Overworld: a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master this world while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected, expert crafter, Steve.

releases.title: Runner
releases.synopsis: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

releases.title: Hope
releases.synopsis: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

releases.title: The Court
releases.synopsis: The Court is an American legal drama television series that aired from March 26 until April 9, 2002.

releases.title: Dark Matter
releases.synopsis: Jason Dessen is abducted into an alternate version of his life. To get back to his real family, he embarks on a harrowing journey to save them from the most terrifying foe imaginable: himself.

releases.title: Mayday
releases.synopsis: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

releases.title: Jagamae Sangeetham
releases.synopsis: Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.

releases.title: The Uprising
releases.synopsis: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

releases.title: Fuze
releases.synopsis: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

releases.title: Korean Kanakaraju
releases.synopsis: Possessed by a Korean spirit, Kanakaraju must navigate his new supernatural identity to protect his family and solve the spirit's murder.

releases.title: Onslaught
releases.synopsis: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

releases.title: Jeevan Bheema Yojana
releases.synopsis: Jeevan and Yojna are a couple drowning in debt who hatch an insurance scheme after crossing paths with Bheema, a stranger who bears a striking resemblance to Jeevan - but things spiral out of control when he turns out to be tangled up in a diamond smuggling racket.

releases.title: G.D.N.
releases.synopsis: G.D. Naidu overcomes challenges and defies a repressive colonial regime to become one of India's greatest innovators.

releases.title: Signal One
releases.synopsis: A computer scientist is invited by a tech billionaire to join his private facility on a Caribbean island to investigate extraterrestrial matter on Earth. When they make contact beyond our world, chaos erupts as we’re left to wonder: do they come in peace?

releases.title: Earle Meets World
releases.synopsis: Alix Earle, Gen Z's ultimate "It" girl, gets real in this unscripted, unfiltered series that goes behind the scenes of her life and family.

releases.title: Parasomnia
releases.synopsis: After playing a guided meditation to induce lucid dreaming, the protagonist begin to experience strange phenomena inside his home. As the dream deepens, the boundaries of reality blur, leading him toward a terrifying encounter with an unknown entity.

releases.title: Teenage Wasteland
releases.synopsis: Inspired by an unconventional teacher, a group of teenagers in upstate New York in the early 1990s make a student film and uncover a vast conspiracy that is poisoning their community. Thirty years later, they revisit their film and confront the legacy of this transformative experience.

releases.title: Puratawn
releases.synopsis: Ritika and Rajeev visit her ancestral house in Konnagar to attend her mother's 80th birthday celebration, only to discover her mother's deteriorating mental state, forcing Ritika to confront this difficult reality and its permanence.

releases.title: Toxic
releases.synopsis: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

releases.title: Unmadham
releases.synopsis: Haunted by his past, a police constable reopens an unsolved cold case. As hidden secrets surface, he must confront truths that challenge his beliefs forever.

releases.title: The Yellow Elephant
releases.synopsis: A documentary on human–elephant conflict

releases.title: The Salt Path
releases.synopsis: The profound story of husband and wife Raynor and Moth Winn, who embark on a 630-mile trek after being forcibly removed from their home. Hoping that in nature they will find solace and a sense of acceptance, they walk through the beautiful but rugged coastlines of South West England - a journey that is exhilarating, challenging, and liberating in equal measure. THE SALT PATH is a powerful portrayal of home, and how it can be lost and rediscovered in the most unexpected ways.

releases.title: Dear You
releases.synopsis: Xiaowei travels to Thailand to find his "billionaire grandfather" who is out of contact due to debt problems, but unexpectedly find the one who has been corresponding with his grandmother for years is not her husband.

releases.title: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
releases.synopsis: During a chase inside a museum, Tom and Jerry find an ancient magical compass and end up being transported through time. Lost in a distant era, they will need to work together to find a way back home.

releases.title: Sardar 2
releases.synopsis: When the mysterious Black Dagger threatens national security, Inspector Vijay embarks on his most dangerous mission yet. As the battle unfolds, the extraordinary origin of legendary spy Sardar is finally revealed, uncovering the sacrifices that forged a legend and the secrets that could shape the future.

releases.title: By Any Means
releases.synopsis: In 1960s Mississippi, a young Black FBI agent is forced to partner with a notorious mafia hitman to investigate a wave of brutal civil rights murders.

releases.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
releases.synopsis: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

releases.title: Mandaadi
releases.synopsis: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

releases.title: The Sun Never Sets
releases.synopsis: While on an unexpected break from her older, divorced boyfriend, a woman runs into her ex-partner, plunging her into a volatile love triangle that threatens to undo her life.

releases.title: The Girl in the River
releases.synopsis: A seasoned criminologist and a young female psychologist are lured to a remote Mississippi town to investigate the murder of a little girl and the disappearance of her twin sister.

releases.title: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
releases.synopsis: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.

releases.title: Maremma
releases.synopsis: In a village bound by ancient traditions, the Maremma Goddess festival is a time of both reverence and fear. Every 12 years, a male bull is sacrificed to the deity, yet with each ceremony, calamity befalls the villagers. Despite their efforts, the elders fail to prevent disaster. Determined to break the cycle, they enact a new decree: any household whose bull bears a male calf in the next 100 days must offer it to the goddess. As the deadline approaches, the fate of the village hangs in the balance, and the true test of their resolve begins.

releases.title: Come with Me
releases.synopsis: Working-class Simon Ward's life unravels after a traumatic home invasion, mounting problems at work and the loss of his best friend. Falling under the influence of rhetoric-spewing radio host Dalton Kirby, Simon spirals into a violent attempt to correct the injustice he believes surrounds him.

releases.title: American Summer
releases.synopsis: Now in his 60s, Mikey vividly journeys back to his childhood during one of the best summers of his life when he met the girl of his dreams, Kelly, scored a spot on the travel baseball team, worked his first job and began his growth out of boyhood — all in the sudden wake of his father missing overseas on a military mission.

releases.title: Yen Ennai Edho Seidhai
releases.synopsis: Broken young man trapped in emotional darkness finds unexpected healing when Madhu's love guides him from self destruction toward hope, purpose, and light.

releases.title: Bol Bhavein Na Bol
releases.synopsis: A boy and girl meet by chance. Their quiet connection grows into love as they learn the most profound feelings need no words. Grounded in innocence, hope, and life's simple beauty, it honors love that's felt beyond expression.

releases.title: Asambhauuu
releases.synopsis: The story is a metaphor for Yudhishthira and the dog, and explores the idea of dharma. Chintu, a dog, loves his owner, Chintan, like a brother. Chintan, too, loves him with all his heart. When fate puts their love and loyalty to the test, they go to extraordinary lengths to fight for each other.

releases.title: Sahaa - Life of Sanju
releases.synopsis: Sanju's journey from childhood to adulthood takes an emotional turn when he meets a young woman named Sahaa, whose presence awakens nostalgic memories from his past.

releases.title: Winkle Twinkle
releases.synopsis: An idealistic political activist returns to a world that has changed beyond recognition, forcing him to confront the clash between his long-held beliefs and modern realities. Torn between family, ideology, and his own sense of identity, he embarks on a deeply personal journey of self-discovery and change.

releases.title: Immortal
releases.synopsis: An unsuspecting man finds himself at the center of a series of mysterious deaths, forcing him to confront a truth that could cost him everything.

releases.title: Parched
releases.synopsis: When the water runs out during the journey.

releases.title: 4 Idiots
releases.synopsis: King, Queen, Jack, and Ace-four misfits surviving through petty crimes in Chennai-found their world turned upside down when COVID-19 lockdowns shut down public transport, their main source of income. Desperate for a way out, King discovered an audio recording about a bungalow filled with black money, supposedly guarded by a lone watchman. Seeing it as their golden opportunity, the gang set out to execute the perfect heist. However, upon entering the bungalow, the door slammed shut behind them, and a chilling voice welcomed them. The so-called security guard was none other than Pulibaba, a notorious gangster. With a gun in hand, he forced them to surrender their belongings and made a sinister phone call: "Doctor, the delivery is ready... Eight kidneys.

releases.title: Wild Tamil Nadu
releases.synopsis: Wild Tamil Nadu is a spectacular new natural history film that reveals the extraordinary biodiversity of Tamil Nadu- a land where rainforests, reefs, and deserts meet in one of the most unique ecological landscapes on Earth.

releases.title: Dilemma
releases.synopsis: The film follows Shravani Manohar Naik, a 35-year-old Indian woman living in the United States, whose life is shaped by a childhood trauma-the acidental death of her mother at age six. Since then, her father Manohar has been her emotional anchor, bound by a promise to never leave each other alone. Now married and pregnant after two miscarriages, Shravani's current pregnancy is her last chance at motherhood. During her fourth month, she abruptly returns to her hometown of Vasai, sensing something is wrong. Her fears are confirmed when she learns her father is terminally ill, with only months to live.  Devastated, Shravani longs to stay with him, but her husband insists she return to the US to secure their child's future. Caught between love, duty, and loss, Shravani must choose between honoring a lifelong bond and protecting the life growing within her, confronting the most paintul crossroads of her life.

releases.title: Ciggie NO Biggie
releases.synopsis: A Cigarette creates a rift between two long-lost friends at the night of their reunion. But the Cigarette chooses its own fate.

releases.title: Resident Evil
releases.synopsis: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

releases.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
releases.synopsis: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

releases.title: The Fix
releases.synopsis: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

releases.title: Practical Magic 2
releases.synopsis: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

releases.title: Don't Move
releases.synopsis: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one.  Suspicion falls on Ricky, the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse.  Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move.  It's up to Megan to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

releases.title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
releases.synopsis: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

releases.title: If I Go Will They Miss Me
releases.synopsis: In Watts, California, a 12-year-old boy attempts to connect with his distant father following his incarceration while sensing mysterious visions, from airplanes and Greek gods, that seem to follow him through his everyday world.

releases.title: Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
releases.synopsis: Follows a woman constable who joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

releases.title: Epic - First Semester
releases.synopsis: Far from home, Aditya wrestles with family expectations, cultural differences and loneliness while studying in London – until he meets the lively Kadali.

releases.title: Enna Vilai
releases.synopsis: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.

releases.title: Haiwaan
releases.synopsis: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.

releases.title: Mahendragiri Vaaraahi
releases.synopsis: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.

releases.title: Serpent's Path
releases.synopsis: A mysterious woman teams up with a man whose daughter was killed and who is now seeking revenge. Together they kidnap members of an organization and torture them to find out what really happened.

releases.title: Fanny
releases.synopsis: The ambitious hairdresser Fanny must survive within the demanding world of the Viennese court. When she pays no mind to the existing rules and moralities of the time, she draws the unexpected attention of the Empress, as well as a public audience.

releases.title: Betty
releases.synopsis: A young woman is haunted by the dead lady in her tub.

releases.title: Dahaan
releases.synopsis: A malicious ancient spirit is unleashed in a haunted mansion. The girl's elder sister and younger brother team up with a pastor to find a way to end the curse which slowly consumes the girl who opened the box.

releases.title: Gator Face
releases.synopsis: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

releases.title: Last Train to Fortune
releases.synopsis: When schoolteacher Cecil Peachtree misses the last train to Fortune, he strikes a deal with outlaw Dooley to secure safe and timely travel.  On the journey, the two develop an odd friendship through the power of knowledge.

releases.title: Jayanti 2
releases.synopsis: When a tribal girl, Payal, is suspended from college for protesting discrimination by her classmates, Santya and Tanuja team up to fight college politics, political pressure, and social ignorance in order to restore her dignity and secure her return.

releases.title: Last Man in Tower
releases.synopsis: Masterji is a retired schoolteacher whose refusal to go along with those around him places him in direct conflict with his own community. His act of quiet resistance ripples outward, throwing into relief the choices and compromises of neighbors – including Mrs. Puri – as an offer of change tests what each of them is willing to hold on to.

releases.title: Singh vs Kaur 2
releases.synopsis: Singh vs Kaur 2 is an upcoming Indian Punjabi-language romantic comedy film directed by Navaniat Singh and produced by Gippy Grewal's Humble Motion Pictures and SVF Entertainment. Serving as a standalone sequel to the 2013 film Singh vs Kaur, it stars Gippy Grewal and Shehnaaz Gill, scheduled for worldwide release on 11 September 2026.

releases.title: Aasha
releases.synopsis: Follows a stubborn, short-tempered widow named Aasha who gets into a tense altercation with a volatile man named Jeemon following a minor road accident.

releases.title: P A L A C E
releases.synopsis: New Orleans’ beloved Historic Palace Theatre is set for demolition, when the supervisor behind the project discovers why it closed down from the souls lost inside.

releases.title: In Love & Struggle
releases.synopsis: Inspired by the visionary philosophy of James and Grace Lee Boggs, In Love & Struggle celebrates Detroit’s enduring spirit of freedom dreaming. The film highlights Detroit’s rich history of grassroots activism and ongoing community transformation, revealing a quiet revolution in action. It calls viewers to reflect on their own being and becoming- to recognize their agency, practice the future they want to see, and tap into the power of neighborly love.

releases.title: Visiting Uncle Paul
releases.synopsis: A short documentary on Brother Paul McMullen, and his life as a Franciscan Brother in Loretto, PA.

releases.title: Mighty Mary
releases.synopsis: Mighty Mary chronicles an amazing group of “we eat nails for breakfast” type of women: the first all-women’s sailing team to contend for the famed America’s Cup, the holy grail for one of sport’s most elite and exclusive racing events.  This team was groundbreaking, beginning with an advertisement in the New York Times.  From there, a group of world class and Olympic sailors as well as Olympic rowers came together, a team which included a deaf sailor, a Native Hawaiian sailor, and the first African American sailor to ever win an America’s Cup race (as a coach of this novice, erstwhile team).  What was dismissed as a publicity stunt turned into something unimaginable. This motley crew (sailing aboard Mighty Mary) stunningly eliminated Stars & Stripes from contention. However, a secret backroom deal the night before the race upended that result. This is a true underdog story about a team which reshaped what could be possible in a sport that had long been inaccessible.

releases.title: Blood Moon
releases.synopsis: Across a single night, a ghost and a vampire drift through a haunting, music-driven meditation on belonging, finding love, tragedy and resurrection in a living–dying–living world.

releases.title: Top
releases.synopsis: Finally at the hospital for his long awaited gender affirming top surgery, Matt Levit, with lively girlfriend Leisha Meyer by his side, navigates the bureaucracy of the top surgery process. But once Matt is thrown deep into surgery day, he suddenly finds his present intertwining with his past self, Kimberly. Plunging through past and present, Matt is dropped into confronting his relationship with his chest and sudden loss of his mother, Nancy.

releases.title: Optimus Prime Awakening
releases.synopsis: An animated epilogue to The Transformers: The Movie (1986) and the final performance of Peter Cullen.

releases.title: Video
releases.synopsis: Video is a found footage, Docudrama by Srinidhi Bengaluru that stars Dheekshith Shetty, Bharatha, Jeevan Shivakumar, Tejesh S M, Priya J Achar, Nalme Nachiyar.

releases.title: Gandharva
releases.synopsis: A story that unfolds between dreams and reality, Gandharva is a heartfelt journey of love told through a poetic and cinematic world.

releases.title: America America 2
releases.synopsis: America America 2 is an upcoming Kannada romantic entertainer film directed by Nagathihalli Chandrashekhar. The film stars Nirup Bhandari, Pruthvi Ambaar, and Shanvi Srivastava in the lead roles.

releases.title: Brindavihari
releases.synopsis: Brindhavihari is an upcoming Kannada romantic musical entertainer directed by Srinivas Raju.

releases.title: Ozhiyathe
releases.synopsis: In August 1976, 19 schoolboys from Koduvayoor were arrested without cause and tormented for 21 days under the Emergency. Ozhiyathe brings this unrecorded true story of injustice and resilience finally to light.

releases.title: Pidha Pachhi...
releases.synopsis: A spontaneous trip takes four friends down a wildly unexpected path after a drunken night ends in missing memories, accidental crimes and nonstop chaos. As they retrace their steps, every discovery makes their hilarious situation even worse.

releases.title: Beporoya
releases.synopsis: The return of Adrit Roy.

releases.title: Ghun Gaon
releases.synopsis: Shanaya, a wildlife photographer, travels alone to the remote village of Ghun Gaon to photograph a rare black leopard. However, she soon discovers a far more sinister and unsettling presence lurking deep within the jungle.

releases.title: Vishwanath & Sons
releases.synopsis: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

releases.title: The Weight
releases.synopsis: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

releases.title: The Master and Margarita
releases.synopsis: A struggling writer in 1930s Soviet Moscow finds his life transformed when a mysterious professor arrives with his bizarre entourage, including a wisecracking trickster, a deadly assassin, a vampire maid, and a giant talking black cat, turning the city upside down while exposing the hypocrisy of those in power.

releases.title: Insidious Rewind
releases.synopsis: Searching for her missing brother, a young woman traces his final signal to an abandoned warehouse, where she discovers a collection of cursed VHS tapes. Captured and forced to watch, she endures four found-footage nightmares that may reveal what happened to him—and what now awaits her.

releases.title: The Dark Heaven
releases.synopsis: In the Hill Village of Mekkarai, Where It is Customary for Men to Die Every Seven Years During the Month of June, a Newly Appointed Police Inspector Arrives to Investigate a Series of Mysterious Murders. As He Digs Deeper Into the Village's Dark Secrets and Long-standing Beliefs, He Finds Himself Trapped in a Web of Crime, Fear, and Hidden Truths.

releases.title: The Musical
releases.synopsis: Doug, a frustrated playwright and middle school theater teacher, learns his ex is dating his nemesis, the school principal. To get revenge and cost him a Blue Ribbon Award, Doug secretly stages the most inappropriate play imaginable.

releases.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
releases.synopsis: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

releases.title: Bad Apples
releases.synopsis: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.

releases.title: The Paradise
releases.synopsis: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

releases.title: Daniel and the Fiery Furnace
releases.synopsis: During the Jewish exile to Babylon, Daniel and his friends face trials as Babylon's armies conquer Jerusalem. Under King Nebuchadnezzar, they gain royal favor but make enemies. Their faith is tested at the fiery furnace.

releases.title: Sunny Dancer
releases.synopsis: Reluctantly sent to a summer retreat for young cancer survivors, a teenager in remission unexpectedly finds deep connections and new beginnings among fellow campers.

releases.title: Cursed Waters
releases.synopsis: Shipwrecked pirates fleeing the Navy wash ashore on a remote island, only to discover it's home to a bloodthirsty cult guarding secrets no one was meant to find. Now survival means escaping both the law and something far worse.

releases.title: The History of Concrete
releases.synopsis: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.

releases.title: Union County
releases.synopsis: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amid the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.

releases.title: It's a Medical Miracle
releases.synopsis: A young man declared brain-dead suddenly awakens with the ability to hear everything. Seeking the nurse whose voice saved him, he's drawn into a dark game of masks, memories, and revenge where every sound may be a clue or a trap.

releases.title: Penance
releases.synopsis: While traveling through an unsafe land, a Soldier and a Princess take shelter in a seemingly empty cavern.

releases.title: Bandkhor
releases.synopsis: Six women from different backgrounds unite to challenge societal expectations. Bandkhor chronicles their journeys toward dignity and freedom as they reclaim their lives and forge their own paths through courage and determination.

releases.title: Take Me Home
releases.synopsis: Anna, a middle-aged Korean adoptee with a cognitive disability, cares for her aging parents in a fragile balance of meeting one another’s needs. Alongside her sister Emily and her father, they must confront challenging questions about the future, but Anna remains determined to build a life where all of them can thrive.

releases.title: Daayra
releases.synopsis: Raman, who has had a shady record with staged encounters and police brutality, finds himself cornered as Ajooni challenges him on every step.

releases.title: Vibe
releases.synopsis: Two inseparable friends' ordinary, unassuming lives spiral into an unpredictable, high-energy adventure that pushes their survival instincts and friendship to the limit.

releases.title: Happy Journey
releases.synopsis: A group of seven women across generations set off on a spontaneous European getaway, leaving their everyday lives behind. Amid the chaos, laughter and picturesque landscapes, the journey becomes an unexpected celebration of freedom and friendship.

releases.title: Amartha
releases.synopsis: After 25 years, village schoolmates reunite to find themselves in vastly different stages of life. Their journey makes them question whether hard work alone determines destiny, or whether an unseen force called Time shapes every fate.

releases.title: Rage
releases.synopsis: Anbu, a taxi driver from Kannagi Nagar, meets Regina, a mute IT employee, during his regular trips and falls for her. When he learns about her troubled personal life, he suppresses his feelings. One night, Regina dies in what appears to be an accident—but soon, it’s revealed to be a planned murder. Shockingly, multiple unconnected people are involved. RAGE follows Anbu’s journey to uncover the truth behind Regina’s death and the tangled motives that led to it.

releases.title: Mitti De Putt
releases.synopsis: Two villages are bound by a rivalry that has outlived the men who started it. For one young man, the feud stops being history the day his uncle murders his grandparents and carries his mother away. Left with nothing but the land beneath his feet and the promise he makes on it, he sets out to answer blood with blood. To bring his mother home, he must first confront the man who took her, and the price the soil demands is heavier than he knows.

releases.title: MANJAR
releases.synopsis: A youthful Marathi family entertainer about friendship, love, family relationships and the unpredictable situations of everyday life, seen through the amusing perspective of an observant cat.

releases.title: L&O - Law and Order
releases.synopsis: After losing his son to a drug empire, DYSP Balagopal joins four fearless recruits to take down the ruthless Pacha and his cartel. The return of legendary gangster Karikkamuri Shanmughan sets the stage for an explosive final showdown

releases.title: Roi Roi Binale
releases.synopsis: Roi Roi Binale is a soul-stirring Assamese musical that weaves together themes of love, art, identity, and the lingering shadows of a region scarred by past turmoil.  Set against the backdrop of a region recovering from the scars of terrorism, Roi Roi Binale subtly explores the enduring impact of trauma. Its central question, whether art should serve the artist or the people, drives the narrative, as each character seeks their own truth. This film breaks all previous records of Assamese movies and collected over 42 crore Indian rupees

releases.title: NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY  SEOUL - THE REDLINE’ in CINEMAS
releases.synopsis: Back after almost two years, NCT 127's fifth tour,  NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY : SEOUL - THE REDLINE’, is coming live to cinemas!  Experience the explosive energy, world-class performances, and electrifying atmosphere of KSPO DOME brought to life on the big screen with immersive sound.  NCTzens, join us for the spectacular kickoff of 'THE REDLINE'!

releases.title: Paris Cafe
releases.synopsis: Olivizhiyaal, from the u.s., dreams of introducing her soulmate kavinSamson, a phd scholar, to the two people she admires most — her parents inIndia. She wants to share a happy news to them. But her smile fades when she learns that her parents, dr. Gautam raja, aSurgeon, and thara, an architect, a fiery social activist, have separated. A buried secret. A shattered trust. A photograph in a paris café that brings thePast crashing back. What did dr. Gautam do? Why did thara, a woman of unshakable ideals, walk away? As oli and kavin dive into the mystery, they uncover a hidden sin, a cry forJustice, and a chance for redemption. A family broken by truth... A daughter determined to heal it. In the end, will forgiveness light the way?

releases.title: BeeP
releases.synopsis: BeeP is a mind-bending crime-fantasy about Ilandevan, a young man who can step inside photographs and uncover the thoughts hidden behind them. But when a life-changing event leaves his extraordinary ability useless, he must find another way to uncover the truth while two seemingly unrelated worlds of college dreams, drugs and murder collide.

releases.title: Ottam Thullal
releases.synopsis: Priest Appu warns Rajan not to cut a sacred Pala tree in Methanam village. Rajan ignores him and dies three days later. Appu predicts five more family deaths in 16 days. Rajan's doubtful son calls it fake, sparking comedic escape attempts.

releases.title: City Lights
releases.synopsis: Follows two individuals who move from a village to Bengaluru, only to confront the harsh realities of survival in a fast-paced, indifferent city.

releases.title: Khoonta
releases.synopsis: A woman bound spiritually to a Himalayan river waits for her missing husband, as her village quietly slips into an uncertain future-where faith, memory, and nature begin to reveal truths no one is ready to face.

releases.title: Lust Stories 3
releases.synopsis: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

releases.title: Digger
releases.synopsis: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

releases.title: Heart of the Beast
releases.synopsis: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

releases.title: East of Eden
releases.synopsis: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

releases.title: Forgotten Island
releases.synopsis: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

releases.title: Primetime
releases.synopsis: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.

releases.title: UNABOMBER
releases.synopsis: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

releases.title: NAZA
releases.synopsis: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.

releases.title: Coven Academy
releases.synopsis: A coven protects their magic school from a dark fate.

releases.title: Livestream from Hell
releases.synopsis: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

releases.title: Family
releases.synopsis: A 10-year-old girl begins to believe her parents are trying to kill her. Convinced a sinister spirit is to blame, she spirals into a haunting fantasy world that mirrors her deepest fears.

releases.title: The Incomer
releases.synopsis: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded "Incomers". Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland.

releases.title: Irreplaceable
releases.synopsis: After witnessing her mother's suicide following a divorce, Xu Chi defies her tragic fate by rising from an ordinary graduate to a sharp-witted top consultant. Drawn into the covert revenge scheme of seasoned partner Ye Xinzhi, who mentors her while navigating their growing mutual attraction, the duo confronts a crossroads when professional upheavals collide with their evolving bond.

releases.title: LEGO ONE PIECE
releases.synopsis: The Straw Hats hit the high seas in a two-part LEGO special! Join Luffy, Nami, Usopp and the crew on their epic journey, fully reimagined brick by brick.

releases.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
releases.synopsis: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

releases.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan
releases.synopsis: Buy! Sell! Profit...or lose it all! University student Kurumi Fukuga jumps into the fast-moving world of foreign exchange trading to recover the 20 million yen her late mother lost. Together with fellow FX enthusiasts Mochiko, Mebuki, and Yasuko, she’ll battle volatile markets where every decision can lead to fortune—or disaster!

releases.title: Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke
releases.synopsis: When the snobbish and wealthy AlThahabi family find out they're actually not as loaded as they think, they're forced to fake their affluence to survive.

releases.title: Charlie Harper
releases.synopsis: As an ambitious chef and her struggling partner move to a new city to start fresh, the stark divide in their drives tests the limits of their love.

releases.title: Invention 13
releases.synopsis: On a cold, windy night, a frustrated pianist encounters strange obstacles while trying to learn  Bach's notoriously intricate Invention 13.

releases.title: Dust
releases.synopsis: Sam's curiosity about life and death deepens on a family backpacking trip, where we see nature, loss, and the cycle of existence through the lens of a six-year-old child.

releases.title: Paolo
releases.synopsis: Follow working-class Paolo's unsettling intrusion into the life of Téophane Tolbiac, a young and up-and-coming politician.

releases.title: Cars: Spooky Halloween Adventure
releases.synopsis: It's Halloween night in Radiator Springs, and Lightning and his best friend Mater are enjoying the festivities at the annual spooky block party. But when Lightning gets bored of the flavored gasoline, roasted lug nuts, and jack-cone-lanterns, he convinces Mater to check out the old haunted garage on the edge of town. Will the two friends be brave enough to make it through the night without getting spooked?

releases.title: The Final Problem
releases.synopsis: In the spring of 1959, a retired actor, who previously played Sherlock Holmes, must investigate a murder at a small hotel on a tiny island near Mallorca.

releases.title: Premada Oorali
releases.synopsis: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

releases.title: Changed Forever
releases.synopsis: CHANGED FOREVER tells the raw and inspiring true story of Alexis, a woman consumed by the darkness of addiction, teetering on the brink of self-destruction. Her life is a whirlwind of bad choices and devastating consequences, leaving her isolated and hopeless. Just when she believes all is lost, a flicker of faith ignites within her. Driven by desperation, her unwavering faith culminates in a profound, life-altering encounter with God, an experience that shatters her old life and rebuilds her from the ground up. CHANGED FOREVER follows Alexis's arduous journey to sobriety, healing, and ultimately, redemption. More than just a story of overcoming addiction, CHANGED FOREVER is a testament to the transformative power of faith and prayer, offering a beacon of hope to anyone struggling to find their own new beginning.

releases.title: Private Eyes West Coast
releases.synopsis: Now leading different lives from their Toronto crime-fighting days, private investigators Matt Shade and Angie Everett encounter a world of different cases along with a new group of friends while solving cases in Victoria, British Columbia.

releases.title: 4 Blocks Zero
releases.synopsis: Travel back to 1990s Berlin and discover the story of a family caught between bureaucracy, politics, and social exclusion, determined to build a new life in Germany.

releases.title: Addicted
releases.synopsis: Each character’s unbreakable addiction stems from unresolved life issues. To avenge herself against the scumbag WANG Fei-Peng, Casey ZHANG quietly approaches his alcohol-addicted wife, YANG Man-ru. Unexpectedly, they become close friends despite their age difference and embark on a path of drug abuse. Anti-narcotics officer CHEN Qi-ming, while investigating the case, reunites with his first love, YANG Man-ru. Their unresolved feelings lead to his guilt and struggle. Their obsessive attachments, akin to addiction, drag them into their own abysses.

releases.title: The Arena
releases.synopsis: Ciryl Gane, Cédric Doumbè and Benoît Saint Denis put 38 amateur fighters through brutal trials and cage fights to win €100,000 and a professional MMA contract.

releases.title: Deadly Tag
releases.synopsis: A brutal chase for survival across a vast battlefield where no one can be trusted and only the last one standing wins.

releases.title: Meesaya Murukku 2
releases.synopsis: After facing rejection in love and getting into a fight, Jeeva learns about his father Siva's struggles and sacrifices. Inspired by his grandfather's legacy and father's dedication, Jeeva changes his outlook and works hard toward his musical dream. Through determination and perseverance, Jeeva earns recognition in the music industry and brings pride to his family.

releases.title: Hunkkaar: The Roar
releases.synopsis: When a teenager accuses a revered cult leader of sexual assault, it sparks a national conflict. As the truth unravels, the line between faith and justice blurs.

releases.title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
releases.synopsis: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

releases.title: Dorothy
releases.synopsis: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence, and toxic masculinity, two childhood friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. Their lives are transformed by the arrival of Dorothy, a woman whose compassion quietly challenges the world around them.

releases.title: The Deputy
releases.synopsis: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

releases.title: Outside
releases.synopsis: Going beyond the four walls, Outside is the latest spin-off from the Sidemen's smash-hit series Inside. A new group of content creators are thrown into the forest to battle for a prize of up to £1 million. With every comfort eating into the prize pot, they'll face brutal decisions, unpredictable challenges and plenty of Sidemen mischief as they fight to keep hold of the cash.

releases.title: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
releases.synopsis: Following a mining accident in northern Chile, 33 miners are trapped deep underground. As the search for them begins, the men are fighting for their lives under extreme conditions.

releases.title: Love Is Blind: Netherlands
releases.synopsis: The hit dating experiment lands in the Netherlands, where a group of Dutch singles date, fall in love and get engaged, all before meeting face-to-face.

releases.title: The Good Spirit: Behind the Doors of the Opus Dei
releases.synopsis: Fourteen men of all ages from eleven different countries recount their personal experiences within Opus Dei. Many of them held leadership positions while others were called to support the institution from the highest levels of their professional careers to expand Opus Dei. Some were sent as teenagers to countries from which they never returned.

releases.title: BOMBAY STORIES
releases.synopsis: Adapted from the short stories of Pakistani writer Saadat Hasan Manto, the film interweaves the lives of three sex workers and their pimps.

releases.title: Don't Be Shy!
releases.synopsis: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.

releases.title: Sam and Colby: Paranormal Investigators
releases.synopsis: Best friends Sam and Colby visit some of the world’s most haunted locations in search of paranormal evidence, trying to answer one question: Are ghosts real?

releases.title: Baththa
releases.synopsis: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster is forced to confront hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unlikely bond begins to grow between the two, changing their lives forever.

releases.title: No Signal
releases.synopsis: Eight influencers accustomed to showcasing an idyllic life on social media attend a transformative retreat to get to know themselves better. What lies behind the perfect life they project?

releases.title: Food Samouraï
releases.synopsis: Sacko Mory immerses himself in Japanese culture and gastronomy to unlock how to prepare the perfect bento.

releases.title: The Stunt Driver
releases.synopsis: Based on the true story of Montrealer Ken Carter, the “Mad Canadian” stunt driver who tried to jump the Saint Lawrence River in a rocket car in the mid-’70s. Carter's dream was to end his 30-year career with a big jump, a big paycheck, and mega stardom. In the process of accomplishing it, he hired a big sports manager and enlisted the best in rocket car design, with the National Film Board of Canada filming a documentary leading up to the event.

releases.title: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos
releases.synopsis: A three-part docuseries examining the life and crimes of notorious American serial killer Aileen Wuornos, who shot and killed seven male clients while working as a prostitute in Florida in 1989 and 1990. She was arrested in 1991 and spent around 10 years on death row before being executed in 2002.

releases.title: Love Lottery
releases.synopsis: When a young woman, Bharani Verma, is found dead under mysterious circumstances, the police quickly arrest Kartik Saxena, making him the prime suspect in a seemingly open-and-shut murder case. But as the courtroom battle begins, every testimony uncovers new questions instead of answers. Hidden relationships, conflicting statements, and buried secrets gradually transform a simple murder trial into a gripping mystery where nothing is as it appears. Beyond the suspense, the film also explores a thought-provoking question: Have marriage and legal battles become a silent punishment for some innocent men, or is the truth far more complex than it seems? With every hearing, the truth becomes more elusive, and just when the verdict seems certain, an unexpected twist changes the entire direction of the case. A taut courtroom suspense thriller that keeps the audience guessing until the very last moment.

releases.title: Crowyokan
releases.synopsis: Comedian Pandji Pragiwaksono turns spontaneous audience exchanges into an intimate and unpredictable crowd-work special.

releases.title: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
releases.synopsis: A look at the controversial 2004 reality series The Swan, which took self-proclaimed 'ugly ducklings' and set out to make them... not that.

releases.title: Yacht Deals Monaco
releases.synopsis: Ambitious sales talents compete in Monaco for a life-changing job in the world of luxury yachts. Under the guidance of yacht broker Cornelius Kistler and yacht consultant Marcela de Kern Royer, they face demanding tasks, high-end clients, and intense eliminations.

releases.title: Dhoomakethu
releases.synopsis: On the morning of his wedding, 36 year old Kuttan wakes from a disturbing dream about his own death. As the day unfolds, familiar moments begin to repeat and reality becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish from memory. Realizing that something is terribly wrong, Kuttan races to uncover the truth before the day repeats itself again.

releases.title: Still Flipping Out
releases.synopsis: Former “Flipping Out” star Jeff Lewis navigates the demands of his hit SiriusXM show on Radio Andy, an eponymous design empire, and everything in-between.

releases.title: Aaram
releases.synopsis: An honest police officer finds himself ensnared in a web of guilt, fear, and moral conflict as institutional pressure and personal integrity collide.

releases.title: Mahakavya: Shri Ramayan Katha
releases.synopsis: A futuristic drama based on the story of the great epic Ramayana with the emotional filming and presentation of the events of Shri Ram's life which has never been seen on screen till now.

releases.title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Reza Oktovian
releases.synopsis: YouTube star and musician Reza Arap takes the hot seat as top Indonesian comics roast his career, controversies and persona in this comedy special.

releases.title: Kill. Bury. Print.
releases.synopsis: When the McCurtain Gazette, a small family-run newspaper, begins reporting on alleged sex, drugs, and violence within the county sheriff's office, they find themselves the target of the sheriff's retaliation. Tensions escalate when the paper obtains a secret recording revealing the sheriff and local officials allegedly discussing having the family killed, turning a local investigation into international news.

releases.title: Mitrata
releases.synopsis: Mitrata follows three inseparable friends whose bond is hilariously and heart-warmingly tested by a chaotic twist of fate. Packed with laughter, loyalty, and life-changing choices, it is the ultimate celebration of the people who know us best.

releases.title: Autobi
releases.synopsis: A woman searching for her missing sister enters a cursed forest, where buried trauma and terrifying secrets blur the line between reality and nightmare.

releases.title: Lenin Pandiyan
releases.synopsis: Set alongside on the riverbanks of Maanamadurai in the Sivagangai district, the premise is about a very gullible, innocent old couple in their late 60s, 70s who inadvertently get intertwined in the political lobby of sand mining which is currently a major issue in the local district. By the orders from a steadfast judge, to ensure protection & safeguard them from the vindictive political system, they nominate a weakest unassuming rookie police constable .The emotional bond between the rookie policeman and the couple & how they avenge the entrenched political system with fortuitous incidents as a new found allies forms the rest of the narrative.

releases.title: Sam Morril: Incorrect
releases.synopsis: Sam Morril delivers savage laughs as he relives his worst one-night stand, compares famous assassinations and details an unorthodox rat extermination.

releases.title: Without Looking Back
releases.synopsis: A story about friendship and a crime that never happened. The main characters are Sonya and Zhenya. One day, they push a guy who was bothering them to the ground and, thinking they've killed him, go on the run.

releases.title: Miller Night Football
releases.synopsis: Chronicles comedian Dennis Miller's unlikely arrival in the "Monday Night Football" (MNF) broadcast booth in 2000, alongside veteran sportscaster Al Michaels and former NFL quarterback Dan Fouts. Intended to reinvigorate the iconic television franchise and attract a broader audience, Miller's addition, and his distinctly cerebral brand of humor, was met with both intrigue and skepticism across sports and television.

releases.title: Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai
releases.synopsis: Caught between family duty and romantic love, a young man faces an impossible choice.

releases.title: Heggana Muddu
releases.synopsis: Ajitha and Prerana's union quickly unravels when mysteries and misunderstandings take over. Humor meets tension as they confront shocking revelations about love, loyalty, and the strangers hiding behind familiar faces.

releases.title: Last Trace with Kaelyn Moore
releases.synopsis: Every case leaves something behind: a grainy frame, a timestamp, a witness who swears they saw something. Last Trace is a weekly show that follows the record to the precise point where it goes cold, and asks what got missed the first time.

releases.title: OUTLORE with Eleanor Neale
releases.synopsis: British storyteller Eleanor Neale unpacks the world’s most compelling true-crime cases, while raising awareness and building a community around the stories that matter.

releases.title: Curse of the Ghoul Logs
releases.synopsis: Halloween's favorite tradition goes post-apocalyptic with the Hallowarrior filmmakers and their trove of Junk O' Lanterns.

releases.title: Matchbox the Movie
releases.synopsis: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

releases.title: Carrie
releases.synopsis: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

releases.title: Below
releases.synopsis: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

releases.title: Buddy
releases.synopsis: A magical, singing orange unicorn holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented.

releases.title: Verity
releases.synopsis: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

releases.title: Doing Life
releases.synopsis: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

releases.title: Ghost in the Cell
releases.synopsis: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.

releases.title: Love of Your Life
releases.synopsis: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

releases.title: Infirmary
releases.synopsis: A guard vanished on his first night at an old psych hospital in 2023. His bodycam footage shows unexplainable incidents that continue to baffle investigators.

releases.title: Merry Berry Love
releases.synopsis: When star Korean spatial designer Lee Yubin loses everything, he heads off to a Japanese island. There, he meets Karin, a resilient strawberry farmer. Hailing from different worlds, their lives collide in a big misunderstanding. Buckle up for "Merry Berry Love," a sweet and sour Korea-Japan rom-com.

releases.title: WAR
releases.synopsis: An anthology series set in the elite world of London law following two rival firms, Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne, as they face off in a different headline-making legal battle each season.

releases.title: Twisted Tie
releases.synopsis: Kang Dojin is a ruthless, perfectionist team leader at a VVIP spatial design agency, and Lee Sunwoo is a rookie who blindly admires him. While secretly nurturing a subtle mutual attraction, their relationship is instantly flipped upside down on a rainy night shift when Sunwoo, losing his mind to Dojin's calculated provocation, crosses the line. Afterward, Dojin suggests a secret, in-office 'hands-on tutoring' session to the confused Sunwoo, placing him firmly under his control. However, Baek Yigeon, a sly manager from a partner company, steps between them and starts provoking Sunwoo. Dojin, who once sought to control everything with pure logic, is gradually consumed by uncontrollable jealousy and possessiveness until his perfect facade completely breaks down.

releases.title: Between Steps
releases.synopsis: Minjae, a former swimmer, lost a leg to illness. Now a PhD student, he's built a quiet, controlled life, until Yujin, a master's student starting over after losing her way, throws it off balance. In a robotics lab, their romance turns fiery, bittersweet, and tender.

releases.title: Cupertino
releases.synopsis: A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

releases.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
releases.synopsis: Rein spent years enhancing his guildmates’ gear with magic, only to be expelled the moment he enchanted everything. Unfazed, Rein steals back his magic, pours it into his own sword, and makes the best of his newfound freedom as he sets off as an adventurer. Along the way, Rein gathers a band of fellow outcasts and together they fight monsters and carve out their place in an enchanted world.

releases.title: Beware Boiúna
releases.synopsis: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

releases.title: Kill Jackie
releases.synopsis: Jackie Price has been living a wealthy, luxurious life for the past 20 years after escaping a dangerous past as an international cocaine dealer. But just as life begins to feel a little boring, she discovers that The Seven Demons, a group of the world’s most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her.

releases.title: Inside the Circle
releases.synopsis: Four lifelong friends are caught in a web of blackmail when a leaked video threatens to expose the secrets that could destroy their friendship.

releases.title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
releases.synopsis: At the heart of a continent of eight kingdoms lies the Marronnier Kingdom. Its general, Baribara, has seven sons, each with a unique gift and serving as a knight commander. Bound by a single noble cause of heroically rescuing a princess someday, the brothers set out as goodwill ambassadors to the seven neighboring kingdoms. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unknown lands?

releases.title: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I'll Cash In with a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
releases.synopsis: In a world where magical Gifts determine your destiny, Lent’s rare ability lets him lend his magic points to others. He forms an adventuring party called the Skypiercers with his friends, helping them become powerful heroes, only to be later cast aside as dead weight. Furious, Lent awakens the true power of his Gift: Forced Collection, the power to repossess magic. His revenge starts now.

releases.title: GET JIRO
releases.synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic, near-future Los Angeles where culinary culture reigns supreme, the world's most powerful figures are chefs, and food is both currency and a demarcation of class, the mysterious sushi chef Jiro sets out on a quest for vengeance.

releases.title: Rolling Loud: The Movie
releases.synopsis: Desperate to reconnect with his distant son, a father secretly takes him to the chaos of Rolling Loud, only to plunge into a wild, frantic search across the massive hip-hop festival when the 13-year-old vanishes into the crowd.

releases.title: I Would Rather Die
releases.synopsis: One cold night, misfit Archie gets bitten by a zombie and after briefly considering ending his life, he decides he's going to figure out what the hell is happening to his body. So, with the help of his only friend and his lifelong crush, Archie sets out to find a cure before he turns into a full-blown monster and kills everyone.

releases.title: Magical Explorer
releases.synopsis: Reborn in his favorite bishojo game, Kousuke gets the worst role possible: the forgettable sidekick. But armed with his knowledge of the game and this world’s largest mana pool, he might even surpass the hero! Now Kousuke must rewrite his fate and battle his way toward the heroines’ happy endings!

releases.title: Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil
releases.synopsis: Nobita and friends finds a secret underwater castle packed with mysteries and riches. With Doraemon's high-tech gadgets, they dive into an ocean adventure mixing humor, teamwork, and imagination in a breathtaking aquatic world.

releases.title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
releases.synopsis: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

releases.title: Vampire Carnival
releases.synopsis: When a grief-stricken young woman visits a mysterious, traveling carnival in her small town, she becomes seduced into a dangerous world of pleasure and deception.

releases.title: Overgeared
releases.synopsis: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

releases.title: #Love
releases.synopsis: The pragmatic creator of a dating app and her adventurous competitor test their theories about love in a 60-day challenge to find their ideal partner.

releases.title: The Torment
releases.synopsis: Kama returns to her hometown and gets entangled in an old missing case. Family secrets, passions and crime reveal that the past never falls silent.

releases.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me
releases.synopsis: Sato may be the most beautiful girl in school but she's also the coldest, never smiling at anyone. When her classmate Oshio spots her at a café, he learns Sato's secret: she's actually just shy and clumsy. As Sato and Oshio bond over their shared interests in photography and desserts, a sweet romance starts to blossom between two socially awkward people.

releases.title: Battle Spirits [Re] ZEKKAI NO KU
releases.synopsis: Keio 3, Hinomoto, Eito. As the Bakumatsu throws Japan into turmoil, young Kuu Bashin dreams of becoming stronger through Standard Battle Spirits. His world changes when he encounters Ajara Zetsu, a wandering samurai and formidable Eternal Battler pursued by anti-shogunate forces. As the worlds of Standard and Eternal Battle collide, Kuu is pulled into Zetsu's journey—and sets history in motion.

releases.title: The World's Strongest Witch
releases.synopsis: Cast out by her aristocratic family after manifesting a seemingly useless skill, Lorna discovers her ability, “Internet,” is an SSS-rank cheat that grants her access to the entirety of the world’s knowledge. All Lorna wants is a peaceful life, but as she collects rare gear and potent items, the “world’s weakest witch” suddenly becomes very powerful, landing in one chaotic adventure after another.

releases.title: NCIS: New York
releases.synopsis: Special Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to the NCIS field office and partners with a roguish agent, Nick Schaeffer, to help lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

releases.title: Repo
releases.synopsis: After his last job went wrong, local fixer John is trying to get out of the game. His criminal boss, Indiana Slim, refuses to give John his final payment unless he does one final job, leaving John with two options: complete one last job, or leave empty handed

releases.title: #I'm Looking for Zombie
releases.synopsis: It may be a ruined city ravaged by zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it's amazing! Having grown up only hearing stories of the old world and the mysterious outbreak that wiped out humanity, she sets off with her childhood friends in search of her missing father. Things quickly become a fight for survival outside the safety of their small village, yet they've never felt more alive.

releases.title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
releases.synopsis: When office worker Akira Yagami gives his life saving a child, he awakens in another world as a weak goblin. But luckily, he’s granted a unique skill that extends his lifespan decades beyond their species limit and allows him to inherit the abilities of fallen goblins. In a realm of powerful races like demons and elves, Akira’s rise to becoming the strongest goblin begins.

releases.title: Eternally Yours
releases.synopsis: Charles and Liz are a charming, married 500-year-old vampire couple whose relationship has survived centuries because, as vampires, divorce isn’t exactly an option. Together, they navigate modern society and their daughter dating a human.

releases.title: Schumacher ’94 – The Birth of a Legend
releases.synopsis: Michael Schumacher's first World Championship win roars to life through personal interviews and archival footage of the legendary 1994 Formula 1 season.

releases.title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo
releases.synopsis: The ultimate police duo is here to keep the peace! Rookie officer Nao just joined the force. She’s got a black belt in judo and earned the nickname “Gorilla” for her insane strength. Then there’s her partner Chojo, who wields every psychic power imaginable. But for a guy who can read minds, he still can’t seem to read the room. Now, these two are taking on crime together in Chinjuku.

releases.title: VERTEX FORCE
releases.synopsis: Akira Todo has always lived in the shadow of his sister, Haruka, who secretly wields their father’s mysterious “Engine.” But when a mysterious enemy comes for his family, Akira is forced into a battle that threatens the entire world. He may have inherited none of his father’s power, but now he must find a way to fight back. Or risk losing everything he cares about.

releases.title: PSYREN
releases.synopsis: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious red phone card. Days later, his childhood friend, Sakurako Amamiya, who possessed the same card, suddenly vanishes. In search of her, he's drawn into rumors of a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances by a secret organization known as Psyren. When he accesses the group, a deadly game that changes his fate forever begins.

releases.title: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet from My Cunning Fiancé
releases.synopsis: Pia Rockwell is a minor villainess in the game Caroline and the Rainbow Magic Sweets. At the end of the game, she's destined to be judged at her graduation party, see her engagement broken off, and be banished from the kingdom. Realizing she's doomed, Pia offers to end her engagement with Rufus Stan…but this only inspires the proud chancellor’s son to make a bet with her about their future!

releases.title: Hanuman Ansh
releases.synopsis: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

releases.title: The Last First: Winter K2
releases.synopsis: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

releases.title: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion!
releases.synopsis: Rose, a lone witch who lives quietly by the lake, is asked by the knight she secretly loves to brew a love potion—for someone else. Though heartbroken, she cannot refuse him, choosing instead to treasure the fleeting time they spend together gathering ingredients. And as the days quietly slip by, Rose finds herself clinging to each shared moment, dreading the day the potion is finally complete.

releases.title: Africa Earth's Wild Home
releases.synopsis: African wildlife and landscapes is brought to the screen like never before, using the latest technology to tell the most extraordinary stories from the continent and cutting-edge CGI to unearth the deep history and forces that shaped Africa's natural worlds.

releases.title: Uncle's Obsession with Cute Things
releases.synopsis: By day, Mitsutaka Oji is the handsome, dependable boss everyone admires. By night, he dotes on his favorite mascot, Pugtaro, and indulges his secret obsession with all things cute! He's kept his double life hidden for years—but one unexpected encounter turns everything upside down and forces Oji to face his feelings head-on!

releases.title: Almari
releases.synopsis: When a family discovers the enchanting powers of their old mysterious cupboard, their lives spiral into a web of desires, drawing both - foes and vices to their doorstep.

releases.title: Nickels
releases.synopsis: A successful entrepreneur and family man is involved in a bike accident involving his neighbor's son, triggering memories of his older brother's tragic death 30 years earlier.

releases.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
releases.synopsis: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

releases.title: From Far Away
releases.synopsis: Noriko is an ordinary high school student, until an explosion pulls her into a world of magic where no one speaks her language. Completely lost, Noriko is rescued by Izark, a shunned swordsman determined to kill the Awakening: a prophesied figure said to control the Sky Demon. As Izark and Noriko bond, he realizes she may be the very person he’s hunting.

releases.title: Who Is Martin Mull?
releases.synopsis: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

releases.title: Locker Diaries: Camp Rock
releases.synopsis: ‪Glimpse the drama unfolding across Camp Rock.‬

releases.title: The Serial Killer Connection
releases.synopsis: The series investigates serial killer Richard “Marc” Evonitz, who kidnapped, assaulted, and murdered multiple young girls (including Sofia Marlene Silva, Kristin Michelle Lisk, and Kathryn Nicole Lisk

releases.title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30
releases.synopsis: As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau. Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.

releases.title: Debipokkho
releases.synopsis: Ishani returns to the Sheel mansion when a sacred golden tongue goes missing, only to be blamed for the theft. As another shocking secret comes to light, she finds herself trapped among a family full of hidden motives. Two wills and a sinister riddle could change her fate forever.

releases.title: Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away On The Girls!
releases.synopsis:
One day during class, Takumi— an otaku — notices his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen.

Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off...

Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away...

Here's Japan’s (probably) first new genre of romcom, "Clicking Away at a Gyaru Who's Mean to Otakus with a Mouse Cursor"!

releases.title: Don't Trouble the Trouble
releases.synopsis: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

releases.title: Prem Keetanu
releases.synopsis: A group of young men and their turbulent college life, where bad grades and hopelessness remain in the driver's seat. Even as they pursue love, friendship and aspirations, the film promises to capture the current generation's struggles and dreams in a light-hearted yet heartfelt manner.

releases.title: Avaraachan & Sons
releases.synopsis: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

releases.title: The Pastor Who Preys
releases.synopsis: Budding fashion designer, Nicole, relocates to a small lake-side town for the summer to work on her first collection and spend time with her cousin, Amanda. When Amanda turns up dead in mysterious accident, Nicole begins to suspect that something is off.

releases.title: Sigma
releases.synopsis: A daring treasure hunter throws caution to the wind, outwitting deadly traps and treacherous allies with sheer nerve and cunning.

releases.title: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
releases.synopsis: Jamie Foxx delivers honest self-care comedy in "Take Care of Yourself." He joins the "Hularious" lineup with Hannah Berner, Ralph Barbosa, Bill Burr, Chris Distefano, Jim Gaffigan, Zarna Garg, Nikki Glaser, Ilana Glazer and more.

releases.title: Disney+ Insider: Worlds Collide Concert Tour
releases.synopsis: Descendants. Zombies. And now, Camp Rock. Three fan-favorite worlds are finally colliding on one stage. Go behind the scenes of the "Worlds Collide Concert Tour" with hosts Trevor Tordjman and Jordan Clark as they get insider access hours before the doors open — seeing an empty venue transform into an all-new arena spectacular.

releases.title: Sweet Deceit
releases.synopsis: Escalating in difficulty round by round, the teams work together to determine what is cake and prove it with their teeth by biting into their best guess, all in pursuit of a total prize up to $12,000.

releases.title: Thella Kaagitham
releases.synopsis: Two teenagers discover first love amid the innocence, mischief, and uncertainties of adolescence. As they fall deeper for each other, the choices they make begin to carry consequences neither is prepared for.

releases.title: Anbil Avan
releases.synopsis: A married couple attempts to start a good life together, but unexpected trouble traps them in an unsettling situation that forces them to fight back for their survival.

releases.title: Impure
releases.synopsis: A dramedy about a woman whose wedding gets called off once her in-laws find out she’s not a virgin

releases.title: Bail
releases.synopsis: After a long wait for justice in a case that affected him personally, retired commissioner Vijay Kumar becomes an outlaw who serves justice.

releases.title: Mojo Brookzz: I Know You Lying
releases.synopsis: Scene-stealer Mojo Brookzz unloads on freaky partners, wild BBL culture and his niece's big coming-out present in his debut Netflix special.

releases.title: Gloria
releases.synopsis: A short film that captures a life-changing dilemma for a Mexican-American bride standing on the brink of traditional expectations. As Gloria prepares to marry her fiancé, Rodrigo, she is consumed by her secret, forbidden love for Emilia—a graceful, queer white woman who refuses to remain hidden in the shadows of heteronormativity. Through flashbacks to the night before the wedding, the film reveals the intense passion and friction between the two women. After an ultimatum from Emilia and a tense discovery by Gloria's sister, Sophia, the reality of their secret shatters the veil of the wedding festivities. Back in the present, Gloria faces a stark ultimatum: if she proceeds with the wedding, Emilia will leave to pursue a life of authenticity and freedom, fleeing the concealment of their relationship.
